title.id: Artikel baru: Kala Raksasa GPU Diduga Mengatur Pasokan Sendiri
title.en: New article: When a GPU Titan Reportedly Engineers Its Own Shortage

body.id: Satu tulisan baru ditambahkan ke blog: "Kala Raksasa GPU Diduga Mengatur Pasokan Sendiri". Tulisannya membahas sorotan regulator terhadap dugaan putaran modal nvidia dan dampaknya bagi pengembang peranti lunak di indonesia
body.en: A new article was added to the blog: "When a GPU Titan Reportedly Engineers Its Own Shortage". It covers antitrust investigations into circular ai venture funding and why global hardware bottlenecks matter to developers everywhere
